title: Derive QQ16 ordered-query residual and restricted Schur obstruction
body:
The borrowed-current-Y shortcut to [PR #3985](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3985) removes 104 negative normalizers but omits the actual prefix correction. This package derives that correction from the pinned full-recovery source and rules out the proposed scalar or 8/16 one-owner-route parallel repair.

The missing query is `Q2(X_T) − M21 Q1(Y)`, where `M21=(1/4) Σ r_p r_pᵀ[g2,p g1,p]`. Constants collapse this operator to `13I`, but the single character `v=1` separates all **104** actual ordered routes. The diagonal `(0,0)` sends that character to **52** distinct characters with coefficient `1/4`; it is not `13I`. Every eight-component query is attainable from actual current Y supported on A, and the A response is injective, so the witness applies to this caller boundary.

The exact restricted optimum is **104 parallel branches**, each allowing arbitrary constant 8×8 channel mixing and one common linear owner permutation. This is **not a native-child lower bound** or a general circuit barrier. Sequential route reuse, paid harmonic projections and changed producers remain outside the model. No native saving, supplier admission or improved κ is claimed.

Evidence in `research/qq16-query-schur/`:
- All 104 literal prefix rows and the complete ordered residual checked over independent current arrays.
- Exact character witness, current-query surjection and response injectivity.
- All 104 borrowed-Y hole maps checked against the full phase polynomial: the bypass has valid frames but wrong values.
- Complete typed receipt, immutable source authentication before inherited execution, normal/optimized Git-free read-only replay, source/manifest/receipt/overwrite rejection controls, and registered package verification.
- Independent parallel-agent and coordinator proof/code reviews and optimized replays, with reviewed hashes recorded in `REVIEWS.json`. No human or formal review claimed.

Scope and stopping decision follow the [coordinated claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3985#issuecomment-6263114494).
